title: Index loop
summary: Proves that the compiler's loop template leaves LeanExe.loop n init f in the state locals, from one obligation about the loop body.
premises: limit and index are distinct locals below scratch that the body does not write
The state locals are among the body's writes
The count evaluates to n in the state before the loop
The state locals hold init's Scalar.values before the loop
For each k below n, the body turns a state holding s into one holding f k s, writing only its writes below scratch
result: A Triple whose postcondition keeps the store, frames every local outside limit, index, and the body's writes, and holds LeanExe.loop n init f in the state locals.
